description:
`discord-to-msg` accepts the messages the WebhookBridge Discord bot forwards from a Discord channel and converts each into UnitySVC's native `msg` format, posted into one of your rooms.

WebhookBridge watches a Discord channel and forwards each new message as JSON (`message`, `display_name`, `message_id`, `attachments`, …). The service maps that event onto the `msg` fields a room takes — the text as `body` (Discord markdown kept as `markdown`), the attachment URLs, and an `origin` of `discord` carrying the Discord message id and the author's display name — and posts it into the room as the member of the connector it came in through, attributed to that connector. The message id doubles as the idempotency key, so a redelivered event is not posted twice. Free.

In UnitySVC open Rooms → the room → Delivery, add a connector for the Discord channel (or use `main`) and choose Discord to Messages as its inbound service; give WebhookBridge the URL the connector shows as the channel's destination. Several Discord channels into several rooms are several connectors. No secrets and no enrollment to set up. See “How to use this service” for the walkthrough.
name: discord-to-msg
summary: Bring Discord messages into a UnitySVC room: WebhookBridge posts each message here, the gateway converts it into a `msg` and delivers it through your room connector.
